$comment: Phase 15 (0.1.3) Task 0 dead-code/deprecation-hygiene scope gate. Machine-checkable source of truth consumed by Tasks 1-5 of plans/015-Release-0-1-3-Dead-Code-Deprecation-Hygiene.md: the allowed hygiene changes (benchmark-runner consolidation + orphan deletion, review-doc archive, non-blocking unused-code sweep, opt-in checkpoint persistence for loaded-skill names + read-path set), the forbidden items (public-export removals, 0.1.4/0.1.5/0.1.6/0.2.0 work, evidence-JSON deletion, ponytail-comment removal), the additive-only compat promise, the audit/signed-tag/provenance policy, per-task evidence tokens, and the hygiene-freeze deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json and 0.1.3 changes none of it. Amendment requires a recorded deviation entry below. Validated by scripts/phase15-freeze.test.mjs. Baseline evidence for regression comparison at the Task 5 exit gate lives in scripts/phase15-baseline.json.

new runtime or dev dependencies (sweep must stay zero-dep; knip rejected)

deletion or modification of any checked-in benchmark-*.json evidence file, freeze manifest, or historical docs narrative (migration.md/performance.md historical runner references stay as historical record)
deletion or rewriting of ponytail: comments (intentional documented shortcuts, not dead code)
breaking changes to the frozen 0.1.x support matrix or public contract surface

compat.promise: additive-only declaration deltas vs scripts/compat-baseline across 0.1.x patch releases; zero breaking deltas at the 0.1.3 bump

supportMatrix: frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json (0.1.x compatibility and support matrix: Node, PostgreSQL, platform, provider, protocol pins, unsupported combinations); 0.1.3 changes none of it

releasePolicy.publication: explicit operator action after evidence review; never automatic
